items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Mary Lou Williams) is not present in the transcript; the mention of Imogene Coca is made by the Interviewer, who narrates an anecdote involving Johnny (Rust Brown) and Imogene Coca.

ctx.x: You know Johnny's the maitre de at a restaurant around here now? Rust Brown?

Yes, he's terrific. He knows the lighting and he knows everything. Imogene Coca was with us there and she was the type that was always nervous about going on. She walked through the club and when she got to the ladies' dressing room - we all dressed in the same room - she'd say, "Oh, we're not going to go over. I know it; I can feel it." And Johnny would hype her real good, make her do a real good show. He was very good at that.
During those years that you were at Cafe Society were you recording too?
